teaser: Sean Turner's natural-language control for agent skills, read as a behaviour policy, and why the description, not the code, stays canonical.
core_idea: A natural-language control checked in CI for every skill contributed to an organisation's repository is an agent behaviour policy for a skill, judged in context by its mandate, reach and inputs; on its own it is hope-based security, so an agent should generate deterministic rules from it while the description stays canonical, and a catalogue of skills in a common ontology turns dangerous combinations into queries.

nodes.label: Hope-based security
nodes.summary: A natural-language control is better than nothing and needs deterministic controls around it.
